final.reason: The one-more-agreement passage already leaves assignment open. Correct heights do not establish a more useful encounter. Retain this source passage and ask whether the extra geometry helps a person notice anything; do not retrofit an imagined visitor into the final. The first human return concerns access to the apparatus; retain the passage until the height encounter itself is described.
